headline: Sensex and Nifty Snap Losing Streak Amid Positive Global Cues and SBI Cybersecurity Launch

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Value buying emerged after a four-session losing streak, lifting the Sensex by over 480 points.
Strong performance in Asian markets, with Kospi soaring 4% and Nikkei gaining 2%, boosted sentiment.
Wall Street gains and anticipation of the upcoming Fed decision influenced global market trends.
JSW Steel and BSE led gains as the Nifty50 closed above the 22,700 mark.
whatHappening: The Indian Rupee slipped to 95.18 against the US dollar, pressured by elevated oil prices.
State Bank of India launched its CyRIS centre to strengthen its cybersecurity capabilities.
NBFCs are curbing fresh rural loans as weak monsoon conditions raise repayment risks.
SFC Environmental Technologies is launching an IPO aimed at high-risk investors seeking long-term growth.
summary: Indian markets rebounded as value buying ended a four-day losing streak, with the Nifty closing above 22,750. Positive global sentiment from Asian and US markets provided support, although the Rupee weakened significantly against the dollar. Key developments include SBI's new cybersecurity initiative and JSW Steel's 5% price gain.
